summary: SMOTE oversampling decreased the minority-class (>50K) F1 score by 0.001008, which is not greater than the 0.02 threshold.
primary_metric_name: F1 score difference (SMOTE - No SMOTE) for minority class (>50K)
methodological_choices: Data preprocessing: filled missing values in workclass, occupation, and native-country with mode values. Feature encoding: LabelEncoder applied to all categorical features. Train-test split: 80-20 stratified split (random_state=42). Model: RandomForestClassifier with default hyperparameters (no tuning). SMOTE configuration: default settings (random_state=42). Evaluation metric: F1 score for minority class (>50K), calculated on held-out test set. The test set was not resampled, ensuring a fair evaluation of both models on the same data distribution.
